title: Gauss's law (3D, 2D)
description: The flux of E through a closed surface (cube, 3-D) or curve (square, 2-D) by Gauss-Legendre quadrature equals the enclosed charge over eps0; charges outside contribute nothing. The divergence residual of a charged ball's field on a grid is checked with pp.maxwell.
